lines: Early in the morning, next to the mountain road connecting Gosha Village to the outside world.
Standing on the frost-laden ground, two women faced each other.
I'm talking about wanting to reaffirm our relationship.
It's difficult to talk in private here. For now, come with me. We both want to avoid trouble, don't we?
(Nothing unusual in my locker... or in my desk...)
It was after school. I had been checking my seat and my locker repeatedly.
(Even though it's the once-in-a-year chance for a maiden in love to confess the secrets in her heart...)
Yes, today was Valentine's Day. The only day of the year when even at Gosha Academy, the training institute for Taimanin, there was a sense of uneasiness in the air.
I had... unfortunately spent the day just as I would any other.
(There was the whole rebellion and all, so I get that it might be kinda tough to approach me.)
(But now that I've been appointed captain of the Independent Commando Unit, there might be one, or two, or ten girls who secretly harbor feelings for me...)
And as I was walking down the hallway more slowly than usual with my overabundant (?) expectations...
Hey, Fuma! So you also got no chocolate?
Shikanosuke called out to me with a brisk look on his face.
I wasn't expecting any to begin with though! Come on, cheer up, Fuma.
Sheesh, to think I'm getting comforted by you. But who knows, there might be a girl waiting for me right around that corner... hm?
Oh, it's Fuma and Uehara. How's it going?
Appearing from around the corner was Akiyama Rinko-senpai. In her hands she had a cardboard box filled to the brim with colorfully wrapped packages.
Yes, same old again this year. My classmates and even my juniors, all sorts of girls are giving me chocolate. I guess you'd call it friendship chocolate?
I'm happy that they are being so considerate, but carrying this much home with me is not easy at all...
I don't think they're just being considerate, though...
Inside the box, you could see some serious-looking handmade chocolate, and also chocolate from high-end sweets brands wrapped in beautiful wrapping paper.
(There's some from the department store in Maesaki City, where Hebiko was saying there's a line every year. So Rinko-senpai shares some of the blame for that...)
Rinko-senpai was hugely popular among the girls as well, and there were even rumors that a secret fan club for her existed.
Well then, see you two tomorrow. Tell the young Sakura-sensei I said hi.
Rinko-senpai said and left carrying her box.
I was ignoring Shikanosuke, whose eyes were gleaming, and slumped my shoulders with mixed feelings, when somebody suddenly slapped me on the back.

I turned around and there she was, the long-awaited girl who harbored feelings for meー
Or not.
It was some guys from my class. They were good friends with Gaiza and they had tried to pick a fight with me previously.
Seeing you two guys go home together, I guess that means you didn't get any chocolate!
I told you! No way the cowardly young master is popular with the girls!
That means I win the bet!!! Gyahaha!
Shut up! What a creepy thing to bet on. And how much did you guys even get!?
Apparently that had been a touchy subject. Our classmates seethed with anger and rushed at us.
